name: webmcp-chrome-extension
description: Chromium 扩展：在页面注入 WebMCP，并从隔离世界发现、调用页面暴露的工具
author: jackdizhu

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && vp pack --filter main-extension-main-world --filter main-extension-content-script --filter main-extension-side-panel --filter main-extension-service-worker
scripts.build:e2e: rm -rf e2e-extension/dist && vp pack --filter e2e-extension-main-world --filter e2e-extension-content-script --filter e2e-extension-side-panel --filter e2e-extension-service-worker
scripts.dev: rm -rf dist && vp pack --filter main-extension-main-world --filter main-extension-content-script --filter main-extension-side-panel --filter main-extension-service-worker --watch
scripts.test:e2e: vp pack --filter e2e-extension-main-world --filter e2e-extension-content-script --filter e2e-extension-side-panel --filter e2e-extension-service-worker && node --experimental-strip-types --test e2e-extension/extension-runtime.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:relay: pnpm --filter webmcp-extension-relay build && pnpm build:e2e && node --experimental-strip-types --test e2e-extension/relay-bridge.e2e.test.ts
